title: A suite test plants an invented identifier in a lookup_eval-sourced pool row and asserts pool check's unstated-names warning
goal: _tools/test_bench.py holds a test, within the suite's tests ceiling, that plants an invented identifier in a fixture pool row built on a lookup_eval.csv case and asserts pool check prints the unstated-names warning with exit 0, and that a hand-written near-miss row naming an identifier absent from the fixture kb is not flagged (BG-fl4sg2py gate g2); today unstated_names and identifier_of have no test.
